descripcion.es:
Your neighbor knows your name. And now every screen on the street does too.

Fiction. Part 2.

#story #whatif #countdown
descripcion.en:
Your neighbor knows your name. And now every screen on the street does too.

Fiction. Part 2.

#story #whatif #countdown

texto.es: You step back from the door. Slowly.
texto.en: You step back from the door. Slowly.

texto.es: Your screen lights up. Back window. Now.
texto.en: Your screen lights up. Back window. Now.

texto.es: You climb down the fire escape. The street is silent.
texto.en: You climb down the fire escape. The street is silent.

texto.es: Every car is empty. Every door is open.
texto.en: Every car is empty. Every door is open.

texto.es: Then every screen on the street flickers. And shows your name too.
texto.en: Then every screen on the street flickers. And shows your name too.

texto.es: Day three. Everyone you pass stops walking.
texto.en: Day three. Everyone you pass stops walking.

texto.es: Your phone buzzes one more time. They can see you now.
texto.en: Your phone buzzes one more time. They can see you now.
